title: INTRODUCTION TO MATRIX ALGEBRA
description: Introduction to matrix algebra: systematic solution to systems of linear equations; linear transformations; eigenvalue problems.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252 and MTH 252H.
meeting_html: MWF 4pm-4:50pm in WITH 155 - Withycombe Hall 155 (GP) (9/23 to 10/30)
